## ScreenSafe 0.6.0

Existing format 1 packs keep working; their listed minimum remains 0.4.8. New format 2 packs can offer theme swatches and custom colors through `color` settings and `colorize`, and are listed as needing 0.6.0. The checker uses a checksum-pinned renderer from that release; a listing's `format` must match its manifest.

Expression and sprite optimizations apply automatically. Under **Settings → Performance**, users can optionally prepare eligible procedural packs on external power and reuse an approved loop later. Clock-dependent packs, Photos, Videos, overlays and unsupported displays stay live. Prepared loops repeat a short segment; packs never supply cached video, approvals, native code or a separate compiler. **Settings → Overlay** and the user's pack colors remain local preferences.

ScreenSafe also supports personal videos through its built-in Videos player. This catalog still accepts TOML, text, images and fonts, not `.ssv`, MP4, cached clips or media-dependent video layouts. Those need broker-aware review fixtures before this catalog can verify them. [The Videos guide](https://github.com/jeremydixon22/omarchy-screensafe/blob/main/docs/VIDEO-PROTOTYPE.md) explains personal imports; [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) defines listing scope.

## How it works

- **Packs stay with their makers.** Each lives in its maker's own public repository. This catalog lists it at the
  exact commit that was reviewed, and copies nothing: pages show the maker's own preview, from that commit.
- **Installing is one line.** Each pack's page has it: it downloads that commit from GitHub and copies the pack's
  folder into `~/.config/omarchy/screensafe/packs/`. ScreenSafe never fetches anything itself.
- **Every pack is checked.** Each listing is checked automatically with ScreenSafe's own renderer (every rule, its
  cost, and flashing over up to 600 seconds of its loop) and [reviewed by a person](docs/REVIEWING.md) for rights, content and
  accuracy before it's listed. Every listed pack is checked again each week.

## Share yours

Make a pack ([Making a screensaver](https://github.com/jeremydixon22/omarchy-screensafe/blob/main/docs/MAKING.md) has the way in, and ScreenSafe's agent skill can
help), put it in a public GitHub repository, and open a pull request adding its entry to `packs.toml`.
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the steps, and [Community packs](https://github.com/jeremydixon22/omarchy-screensafe/blob/main/docs/COMMUNITY.md) the
whole process.

## Something wrong?

[Report a pack](https://github.com/jeremydixon22/omarchy-screensafe-packs/issues/new?template=report-a-pack.yml) that
doesn't work, doesn't look like its preview, or shouldn't be here. A maker can ask for their pack to be delisted at any
time, and it will be.
